title: Repeated regexp compilation
summary: Compiling regular expressions repeatedly instead of reusing compiled patterns.
rationale: regexp.Compile and MustCompile are much more expensive than matching.

detection.notes: Find regexp.Compile or MustCompile inside loops or handlers.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Hoist compiled regex values to package-level vars, init-time construction, or bounded caches.
remediation.tradeoffs: Dynamic patterns may require validation and cache eviction.
